data.one_liner: Listen for any hardware barcode scanner without manufacturer SDKs.
data.what_it_does: It listens for raw keyboard events from hardware barcode scanners that act as keyboards. It groups fast character sequences ending with an enter key and triggers a callback when a barcode is recognized.
use_when: You are using a hardware barcode scanner that acts as a keyboard and doesn't require focus on a text input.
You need cross-platform support for hardware scanners without implementing per-manufacturer SDKs.
avoid_when: You only need to capture barcodes via the device's built-in camera.
You are satisfied with using a focused text input control (TextField) to capture scanned text.
strengths: Supports external hardware scanners including bluetooth and wifi ones.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Relies on timing and buffering heuristics to differentiate between manual typing and barcode scans.
May require tuning parameters like bufferDuration or useKeyDown depending on the platform.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick mobile_scanner if you want to scan barcodes using the device camera rather than external hardware keyboard scanners.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick google_mlkit_barcode_scanning for advanced on-device camera-based barcode and QR code detection.
